verdicts.reason: A reads left to right like a proper banner: the can sits inside its circle, then brand, headline, body copy with badges, and the CTA anchored on the right, where it is clearly visible. Its flaws are a very tiny can and cramped body copy and badges. B splits the circle (stranded at the far left) from the can (stranded at the far right), and puts the wordmark below the headline. Its CTA shrinks into a small pill at bottom-left that has the same weight as the badges, and the body copy is illegibly small, all crammed into the bottom row.
